scenes.title: Riding a Bike
scenes.summary: Hippolyte Rivière tells Guy Marchand about his biking routine. They prepare to go over their lines.

scenes.title: Guy Forgets His Lines
scenes.summary: During a rehearsal on set, Guy Marchand forgets his lines and acts confused, thinking the director is asking him to strip.

scenes.title: Minor Stroke
scenes.summary: A doctor examines Guy Marchand and diagnoses him with a minor stroke, explaining that the confusion will pass in time.

scenes.title: Extending the Contract
scenes.summary: Camille asks Mathias to sign her contract extension because Andréa is being difficult.

scenes.title: The Mustache
scenes.summary: Hervé calls Camille 'Jean Gabin'. Camille tells Mathias she feels like people are treating her differently now.

scenes.title: Junior Agent Priority
scenes.summary: Andréa vents to Gabriel about Guy's stroke. She then asks Gabriel about hiring a junior agent, but he says it's not a priority.

scenes.title: Intense Rehearsals
scenes.summary: Sofia returns exhausted from an intense rehearsal with Julien Doré. Gabriel gets jealous and they argue about her boundaries.

scenes.title: Pulling Guy Out
scenes.summary: Gabriel updates the team about Guy Marchand's condition. They discuss the economic sense of replacing him early.

scenes.title: The New Junior
scenes.summary: Hicham interrupts the meeting to announce his decision to appoint Camille as the new junior agent.

scenes.title: Chet Baker
scenes.summary: Arlette tells Gabriel about her past relationship with Guy Marchand and how she dumped him for Chet Baker in New York.

scenes.title: Judas Barneville
scenes.summary: Hervé reads a Bible passage to Camille, aggressively calling her Judas for taking the junior agent job.

scenes.title: Destiny Knocking
scenes.summary: Camille cries in the restroom. Andréa comforts her, saying she believes in her and that this is destiny knocking.

scenes.title: Pregnancy Test
scenes.summary: Andréa and Camille discover a positive pregnancy test in the restroom and wonder who it belongs to.

scenes.title: I Can and I Will
scenes.summary: Gabriel talks to Guy on set. Guy insists he will finish the movie and asks Gabriel not to replace him.

scenes.title: Hippolyte's Agent
scenes.summary: Hippolyte Rivière gets drunk and asks Camille to be his agent, causing tension with the rest of the team.

scenes.title: The France 2 Lady
scenes.summary: Guy acts his scene perfectly. Elisabeth Lecœur from France 2 visits the set and meets Gabriel.

scenes.title: Hidden Penophagy
scenes.summary: Gabriel talks to Elisabeth Lecœur about Julien Doré's script, accidentally revealing a violent scene involving a chopped-off penis.

scenes.title: The Butter Trick
scenes.summary: Gabriel and Guy are at the canteen. Guy makes a mistake with the pepper. Arlette comes by with her dog.

scenes.title: Arlette Davidson
scenes.summary: Arlette visits Guy to check on him. Her dog Jean Gabin makes an appearance.

scenes.title: Showing the Apartment
scenes.summary: Real estate agent Sylvie Dujol shows Mathias's apartment to prospective buyers. Later, Mathias feels overwhelmed.

scenes.title: I'm Pregnant
scenes.summary: Andréa catches up to Hicham while he's jogging to tell him that she is pregnant and asks for a few minutes to talk.

scenes.title: Turning Down the Promotion
scenes.summary: Camille tells Hicham she wants to turn down the promotion. Hicham tells her to take it or leave the agency.

scenes.title: Sheer Hell
scenes.summary: Camille calls her mother crying about how the others at the agency are treating her. Her mother tells her to come home.

scenes.title: Swapping Roles
scenes.summary: Guy and Hippolyte rehearse a scene. Guy forgets his lines and Hippolyte helps by swapping roles to get a feel for the scene.

scenes.title: Dead in the Water
scenes.summary: Julien Doré is furious that France 2 pulled financing because of the 'hidden penophagy' Gabriel accidentally mentioned.

scenes.title: Un verre après le tournage
scenes.summary: Guy thanks Arlette and they agree to get a drink together at a little café down the road.

scenes.title: La révélation d'Andréa
scenes.summary: Andréa tells Hicham about the pregnancy, revealing it was from a threesome and she plans to get an abortion. Hicham introduces Colette Brancillon to Andréa.
